_comment: The ffmpeg build package.ps1 ships beside vhs-studio.exe. A pinned, dated
autobuild from BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds rather than the rolling 'latest' asset,
so the zip is reproducible and the digest below can be checked. The
'shared' variant is used: small ffmpeg.exe/ffprobe.exe plus the av*.dll
libraries, about half the size of the static build. 'gpl' because the
app's H.264/HEVC exports use libx264/libx265, which the LGPL build lacks.
To move to a newer build: pick an asset from
sha256 digest from the release page here.
